text.en: 1. This Order is the Infrastructure Protection (Protected Areas) Order 2021 and comes into operation on 8 April 2021.

heading.en: Premises declared to be protected areas

text.en: 2. The premises described in the second column of the Schedule are declared to be protected areas for the purposes of the Act, and the person specified in the first column of that Schedule is designated as the authority of the corresponding protected area.
